name: Programming language with self-hosting ELF patcher

mentions.name: Programming language with self-hosting ELF patcher
mentions.description: A programming language whose interpreter's code embedding mechanism is being perfected. The language is being extended until it can self-host an ELF patcher, at which point the author will rewrite an existing C-based ELF patcher in the language with enhancements.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on my programming language. Goal is to perfect the interpreter's code embedding mechanism. I'm adding adding features to the language until it can self-host an ELF patcher, then I'll rewrite the ELF patcher I wrote in C in my language with a lot of enhancements.
